# Correct two over-claims in the 13.2 notes' split chapter

## Context

#19497 merged the 13.2 notes' repositories-split chapter (#19491). While reviewing the split post (#19495, now #19508), @neo-gpt found two over-claims, and the chapter carries both (A2A, 2026-10-09 15:30Z; Grace's FYI at 15:34Z). I verified both before filing.

## The Problem

- **Two size metrics read as one.** The opening sets "a fresh clone … receives a 252 MiB pack" beside "GitHub measured the same repository at 5.21 GiB". The 252 MiB is a bare clone's pack ([receipt](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19491#issuecomment-6082833515)), and the 5.21 GiB is GitHub's reported storage (#17376). Set side by side, they read as a before-and-after of one measurement.
- **"Thirty-one minutes" overstates a fresh start.** The note says the repository's structure "was written down as the target rather than derived from the old tree", and that "a fresh repository is easier". But the Institution's first commit, [`c78f9624a8`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-institution/commit/c78f9624a83c65963cb6eb61df89615c69482d1f) ("initial files", 20:23:41Z), added 134 files and 32,242 lines. Its `apps/agentos/store/FleetRoster.mjs` (blob `f374859cfd`) is byte-identical to the Engine's copy, which entered the Engine on 2026-07-10 (#14920) and left on 2026-08-27 (#17810). The app first ran at the third commit, [`f21adf8ba8`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-institution/commit/f21adf8ba89a31e5369ecd7b470f7920eaee6fd9) (20:54:30Z). The existing source was ported into a layout written first.

## The Architectural Reality

- `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/v13.2.0.md`, chapter *The repositories split*: its opening paragraph, and the `[!NOTE]` *Thirty-one minutes*.
- **Receipt:** `gh api repos/neomjs/neo --jq .size` returned 249218 at 2026-10-09T15:35:03Z. GitHub reports that field in KiB, so it is 243 MiB. It is the same instrument as the 5.21 GiB.
- The post's repair at #19508 `0a58421e07` states both bounds, and the chapter should agree with it.

## The Fix

- The opening gives GitHub's storage figure then and now (5.21 GiB on August 19, 243 MiB today), and the 252 MiB pack as what a fresh clone downloads.
- The note says the layout was written down first and the existing Fleet Manager source was ported into it: 134 files at 22:23 CEST, and the app running at the third commit, at 22:54. The lesson becomes "write the target first, then port into it".

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 No sentence sets 252 MiB beside 5.21 GiB as one measurement. Each figure names what it measures, and today's GitHub figure links this ticket's receipt.
- [ ] AC-2 The note claims no fresh implementation. It states the port, the first commit's size, and the third commit as the first running app.
- [ ] AC-3 Nothing else in the chapter changes, and the release-note link scan passes.

## Out of Scope

The split post (#19508, Grace's), and the chapter's other figures, which Euclid confirmed.
